fact: In a reply dated 31 December 2025 the Acting Minister of Police said a case docket is opened at the Community Service Centre from the complainant's oral statement, checked by the Shift Commander and then captured/registered on the CAS/ICDMS, handed to the Detective Commander physically and on the system, and that SAPS is implementing system upgrades to address data-integrity problems in the statistical value chain.
title: Question NW6007 to the Acting Minister of Police
